title: The 8 Best Jigsaw Blades for Wood 2026
h1: The 8 Best Jigsaw Blades for Wood 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for jigsaw blades for wood 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at jigsaw blades for wood 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Bosch T101BR 5 pc. Reverse Pitch Clean for Wood T-Shank Jigsaw Blades
products.blurb: Key specs: Reverse tooth design cuts on the down stroke, Reduces tearout on finished wood faces, 10 TPI for smooth cuts.
strengths: Reverse tooth design cuts on the down stroke, keeping tearout on the bottom face rather than the visible top
Critical for plywood -- the face you see stays clean and the back accepts the tearout
10 TPI provides smooth cuts in hardwood without the slowness of higher tooth counts
Bosch blades are the most consistently manufactured T-shank blades in the market
limitations: Not suitable for aggressive material removal -- slower cut than lower TPI blades
Reverse tooth requires cutting with the good face down to keep it clean
features: Reverse tooth design cuts on the down stroke
Reduces tearout on finished wood faces
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: Bosch T101AO 5 pc. Clean for Wood T-Shank Jigsaw Blades
products.blurb: Key specs: 10 TPI up-cut tooth design, Clean cuts on top face, Works with hardwood and softwood.
strengths: Standard up-cut design for maximum versatility
10 TPI produces a clean top face without needing to flip the workpiece
Works in all wood types including MDF and particle board
The correct blade for cuts where the top face is visible and the bottom is hidden
limitations: Tearout on the bottom face -- not suitable when both faces must be clean
Slower than aggressive blades for rough cuts

products.name: Diablo DJT5S Jig Saw Blade Set for Wood & Metal (5-Piece)
products.blurb: Key specs: Multi-material set, Bi-metal construction, Several TPI options.
strengths: Multi-purpose set covers wood, metal, and plastic in one purchase
Bi-metal construction lasts significantly longer than carbon steel blades in wood
Multiple TPI options in the set address different materials and cut quality requirements
Diablo blade quality is second only to Bosch in the T-shank market
limitations: Set is general-purpose rather than optimized for wood specifically
Higher cost than buying individual blades for a specific task

products.name: Milwaukee 48-42-5190 Bi-Metal Jig Saw Blades, 14 TPI (5-Pack)
products.blurb: Key specs: Bi-metal blades, Multiple TPI options, T-shank.
strengths: Bi-metal construction extends blade life in hardwood
Optimized for Milwaukee jigsaw blade clamping system
Complete set covering fine to aggressive wood cuts
Milwaukee blade quality matches their tool quality reputation
limitations: Designed primarily for Milwaukee jigsaws -- minor fit differences in other brands
Higher cost than basic carbon steel blades

products.name: Makita A-85911 Jigsaw Blades for Wood
products.blurb: Key specs: Japanese-manufactured blades, Wood-specific tooth geometry, Consistent tooth set for clean cuts.
strengths: Japanese-manufactured blade steel holds an edge longer than many imported budget blades
Wood-specific tooth geometry rather than a generic multi-material blade
Consistent quality control keeps cut quality uniform blade to blade
Works in Makita jigsaws and fits most universal-shank tools
limitations: Higher price per blade than basic carbon steel options
Best matched to Makita jigsaws for optimal fit
features: Consistent tooth set for clean cuts
Fits Makita and most universal-shank jigsaws
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: DEWALT DW3742C 14-Piece T-Shank Jig Saw Blade Set with Case
products.blurb: Key specs: 14-blade set, T-shank and U-shank included, Multiple TPI for wood, metal, plastic.
strengths: 14-blade set is the largest in the category -- covers every cutting situation
T-shank and U-shank included for compatibility with both old and new jigsaws
Storage case keeps blades organized and protects teeth
DEWALT blade quality is consistent for carbon steel blades
limitations: Carbon steel (not bi-metal) -- shorter life in extended hardwood use
Larger set means more blades of types you may rarely use
features: Multiple TPI for wood, metal, plastic

products.name: LENOX Tools 1991384 T-Shank Down Cutting Wood Jig Saw Blade (3-Pack)
products.blurb: Key specs: Bi-metal gold construction, Patented Progressive Technology teeth, Variable pitch reduces vibration.
strengths: Bi-metal construction provides the longest blade life in the standard wood blade category
Progressive tooth spacing reduces vibration during the cut
Variable pitch means the blade cuts more smoothly with less chatter
Lenox is the leading bi-metal blade manufacturer in North America
limitations: Higher price per blade than carbon steel alternatives
Progressive pitch is better for curved cuts -- less ideal for very tight radius work

products.name: Diablo DJT101AO5 Scroll Cut Wood T-Shank Jigsaw Blades, 20 TPI (5-Pack)
products.blurb: Key specs: Narrow blade width for tight curves, High carbon steel, Multiple sizes for radius control.
strengths: Narrow blade width allows tighter radius curves than standard-width blades
Multiple narrow widths in the set allow choosing the minimum radius needed for each cut
Aggressive tooth pattern removes material quickly in curves
High carbon steel is appropriate for occasional curve cutting
limitations: High carbon steel -- not as long lasting as bi-metal in extended use
Narrow blades deflect more than wide blades in thick hardwood
features: Narrow blade width for tight curves
